verses.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection

verses.t: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection]
verses.pickthall: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true)

verses.t: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones

verses.t: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips
verses.pickthall: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers

verses.t: But man desires to continue in sin
verses.pickthall: But man would fain deny what is before him

verses.t: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection

verses.t: And the sun and the moon are joined

verses.t: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape

verses.t: No! There is no refuge

verses.pickthall: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind

verses.pickthall: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself

verses.t: Even if he presents his excuses
verses.pickthall: Although he tender his excuses

verses.t: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an
verses.pickthall: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it
